concerns.concern: The combustion extension is a bounded E3 equilibrium simulation, not an experimental or transient-ignition result; shared gri30 and protocol dependence leave mechanism and condition extrapolation unvalidated.

The solubility external evaluation is entirely OOD, while target-condition semantics and uncertainty calibration are not shown to transfer; it cannot support population-wide model failure or generalization claims.
The battery archive lacks capacity, resistance, uncertainty, and condition-complete cross-cell metadata, so degradation decisions cannot be inferred from available voltage/current traces.

Materials records remain discovery metadata without matched composition, processing, microstructure, hydrogen environment, loading, property, method, uncertainty, and locator fields; comparative embrittlement conclusions are therefore not testable.

Docking support shares one receptor structure and protocol, with limited protocol variation and no measured affinity or efficacy validation; score separation should not be treated as biological effectiveness.

Passing bundle replay and ledger checks establish provenance and integrity, but do not establish independent fresh engine replication; this distinction limits reproducibility claims based on replayed artifacts.
The combustion result supports only a bounded E3 condition-map extension; it does not provide an E4 experimental comparison or justify broader physical-performance claims.
The solubility external set was entirely OOD, so it cannot support population-wide failure or unrestricted generalization; the conclusion must remain sample- and applicability-bound.

Battery and materials evidence remains insufficient for degradation or embrittlement decisions because required condition, outcome, and uncertainty fields are absent; missing data must not be interpreted as a negative result.
Docking support is strongly dependent on one receptor structure and one computational protocol; score separation cannot be promoted to measured affinity, efficacy, or general biological activity.

Bundle integrity, ledger validation, and replay establish provenance and reproducibility of recorded artifacts but do not constitute independent fresh engine executions or elevate computational evidence levels.

The three fresh v5 computational runs have registered run IDs, input/run/bundle hashes, explicit conditions, combustion mechanisms, evidence levels, passing bundles, and successful ledger integrity checks. This supports bounded computational replay, not experimental validation.

Exact environment-level reproduction is not established because the supplied state does not expose engine/package versions, complete environment manifests, full execution configurations, or applicable dataset/model hashes. Bundle PASS verifies provenance and integrity, not fresh engine re-execution.

The phi=1.05 combustion extension is reproducible only as a bounded E3 Cantera equilibrium result under declared conditions. No compatible E3-to-E4 comparison or matched experimental observation is recorded.

Docking reproducibility and interpretation remain dependent on the single 1PXX receptor/protocol configuration, with no independent structure or measured binding validation. The E2 ceiling and non-efficacy boundary should remain in force.

Condition-complete external reproducibility remains blocked: the solubility records are OOD, battery records lack required capacity/resistance/uncertainty fields, and materials records lack matched condition-complete observations. Existing no-decision boundaries should be preserved.
